_about: One good and one bad element for each list `ledger integrate` reads (tools/report_check.py check_lists). The shapes are those of archived intake reports (provenance in the phase 2 follow-up 5 hand-back); the values are rewritten from the casebook corpus (tools/example-casebook.md), so nothing real is named. `bad_says` is a fragment the check's message must carry.
